pages.title: Read the situation

pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: If I took the job
paragraphs: Two fictional offers, same salary and training: A has a ten-minute commute and fixed 9–5 hours. B has a one-hour commute on three office days, two remote days and advertised flexible hours. The exact afternoon arrangement is not confirmed.

pages.title: Exploring the offer
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: If you took the new job, what would change most?
lines.audioText: If you took the new job, what would change most?
lines.translation: Se aceitasse o novo emprego, o que mudaria mais?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d have more flexibility, but a longer commute
lines.audioText: I’d have more flexibility, but a longer commute.
lines.translation: Eu teria mais flexibilidade, mas um trajeto maior

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Would the longer journey be a problem every day?
lines.audioText: Would the longer journey be a problem every day?
lines.translation: O trajeto maior seria um problema todos os dias?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Only on three days. I could work from home twice a week
lines.audioText: Only on three days. I could work from home twice a week.
lines.translation: Só em três dias. Eu poderia trabalhar de casa duas vezes por semana

questions.prompt: How often would the person commute under B?
questions.cue: Use the arrangement, not just the journey length

pages.title: Advice after understanding the priority
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What would matter more to you: the journey or choosing your hours?
lines.audioText: What would matter more to you: the journey or choosing your hours?
lines.translation: O que importaria mais: o trajeto ou escolher seus horários?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m not sure yet. I’d like time for a course in the afternoon
lines.audioText: I’m not sure yet. I’d like time for a course in the afternoon.
lines.translation: Ainda não sei. Gostaria de ter tempo para um curso à tarde

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Then I’d ask whether the flexible hours really include afternoons
lines.audioText: Then I’d ask whether the flexible hours really include afternoons.
lines.translation: Então eu perguntaria se o horário flexível realmente inclui as tardes

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Good idea. If they didn’t, the offer would be much less useful
lines.audioText: Good idea. If they didn’t, the offer would be much less useful.
lines.translation: Boa ideia. Se não incluísse, a proposta seria bem menos útil

questions.prompt: Why is the afternoon arrangement important?

questions.answer: Because they want to attend an afternoon course

pages.title: The priority behind the choice
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. I’m most concerned about having time for an afternoon course. A higher salary would be welcome, but it isn’t the main reason I’m thinking of changing jobs. I’d accept a longer commute on some days if the flexible hours were real. Before I choose offer B, could you help me decide what to ask the employer? They haven’t confirmed whether I can keep my afternoons free. I’d like to check that before accepting
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. I’m most concerned about having time for an afternoon course. A higher salary would be welcome, but it isn’t the main reason I’m thinking of changing jobs. I’d accept a longer commute on some days if the flexible hours were real. Before I choose offer B, could you help me decide what to ask the employer? They haven’t confirmed whether I can keep my afternoons free. I’d like to check that before accepting.
